How do I use it properly the very first time?
Message from YETI Virtual Outfitter:
For the first use of your Hopper Flip® 8 Soft Cooler: 
Pre-chill the cooler with sacrificial ice before packing your already chilled food and drinks.
Use about two-thirds ice and one-third contents. For the Hopper Flip® 8, the recommended capacity is up to 6 cans with an ice-to-contents ratio of at least 2:1.
Pack any remaining air space with ice or towels to help maximise cold retention.
After use, clean it with mild dish soap, water, and a gentle cloth. Rinse it, wipe the inside dry, and leave the HydroLok™ Zipper open until completely dry.
Keep the zipper free of debris and apply a thin layer of the included lubricant to the front and back of the top seal and adjoining teeth when needed.
Store it fully closed and completely dry. Do not machine wash it or dry it in an oven or clothes dryer.
Do not use dry ice in this soft cooler.
